title: Port recent outcome recording, completion reactions and shallow readouts
scope: Record/update/readout bodies of remember/recentOutcomes over caller-owned run handles and delivered completion reactions. Preserve exact run identity, source100 oldest eviction, raw since/ISO/duration order, late evicted completion, newest-first job filtering and shallow result/error sharing. Executor attaches and retains once-only reactions; actual promise/runtime integration remains separate.
acceptance: Full pinned original graph runs independent clocks, completion/observer-failure, eviction and shallow-copy schedules first; compare complete retained snapshots and caller/observer state.

Clock/normalizer evaluation precedes assignment; failed observer leaves caller outcome unchanged. Typed errors, kept data and UTC conversion reuse existing ports; sourcehost limits/abandonment are separate.
open_items: Implement source recording/update/readout bodies at owned reaction boundary; executor reaction attachment and general non-JSON host conversion remain separate.
